title: Insured Plan of Care Recertification, Progress Report and Re-Evaluation Standard
content:
**Clinical documentation standard — Insured Plan of Care.**

**Recertification.** Where the payer program requires physician certification, a new certification period starts the day after the current certification end date and ends the payer program's recertification interval, in calendar days, later. It is recorded only when the physician signs the updated plan, and the new period may start no earlier than the day after the prior one ends.

**Progress reports.** On every payer program, once the number of treatment and telehealth treatment visits billed on the plan since its latest evaluation, re-evaluation or progress report visit reaches the payer program's progress report interval less one, the next visit is billed as a progress report visit, which resets the count.

**Re-evaluations.** A re-evaluation visit is billed only when the plan of care changes materially or at recertification, never routinely.

## Progress report cadence (hypothetical sequences)

| Progress report interval | Treatment visits billed since the latest evaluation, re-evaluation or progress report | Next visit billed as |
|---|---|---|
| 10 visits | 8 | Treatment visit (count becomes 9) |
| 10 visits | 9 | Progress report visit (count resets) |
| 12 visits | 10 | Treatment visit (count becomes 11) |
| 12 visits | 11 | Progress report visit (count resets) |

## Recertification dates (hypothetical)

A current certification period ending on 2026-04-05, on a payer program with a 90-day interval: the new period starts on 2026-04-06 and ends on 2026-07-05, and it is recorded only once the physician has signed the updated plan. A new period may not be given a start date earlier than 2026-04-06.
